```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

set.seed(1031)
```

## Synthetic regulatory data

```{r data}
region_start <- 106.84
region_end <- 107.24
promoter_position <- 107.041

candidate_elements <- tibble(
  element_id = sprintf("E%03d", seq_len(96)),
  position_mb = sort(runif(96, region_start, region_end))
) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_mb = abs(position_mb - promoter_position),
    local_peak = exp(-0.5 * ((position_mb - promoter_position) / 0.018)^2),
    distal_peak = exp(-0.5 * ((position_mb - 107.171) / 0.006)^2),
    re2g_score = pmin(1, 0.04 + 0.55 * local_peak +
      0.23 * distal_peak + rbeta(n(), 1.1, 6.5) * 0.36),
    abc_score = pmin(1, 0.015 + 0.76 * local_peak +
      rbeta(n(), 0.9, 8) * 0.14),
    contact_frequency = pmin(0.22, 0.01 + 0.18 * local_peak +
      rbeta(n(), 1.1, 7) * 0.055),
    nearby_activity = pmin(4200, 40 +
      rgamma(n(), 1.35, 210) + 2900 * distal_peak + 1050 * local_peak),
    distance_scaled = distance_mb / max(distance_mb),
    tss_between = if_else(position_mb < 106.858 | position_mb > 107.168, 1, 0),
    elements_between = abs(rank(position_mb) -
      which.min(abs(position_mb - promoter_position)))
  )

link_data <- candidate_elements %>%
  arrange(desc(re2g_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 13) %>%
  transmute(
    element_id,
    element_position = position_mb,
    promoter_position = promoter_position,
    link_strength = re2g_score
  )

gene_models <- tribble(
  ~gene, ~start_mb, ~end_mb, ~direction, ~gene_y, ~gene_colour, ~label_x,
  "PIK3CG",  106.857, 106.905, -1, 9.56, "#606060", 106.849,
  "PRKAR2B", 107.041, 107.158,  1, 9.57, "#111111", 107.001,
  "HBP1",    107.148, 107.204, -1, 9.29, "#464646", 107.145,
  "COG5",    107.195, 107.241, -1, 9.56, "#696969", 107.180
) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_start = if_else(direction > 0, start_mb, end_mb),
    plot_end = if_else(direction > 0, end_mb, start_mb)
  )

make_exons <- function(gene, positions, y, colour, width = 0.0030) {
  tibble(
    gene = gene,
    xmin = positions - width / 2,
    xmax = positions + width / 2,
    ymin = y - 0.105,
    ymax = y + 0.105,
    exon_colour = colour
  )
}

gene_exons <- bind_rows(
  make_exons("PIK3CG", c(106.859, 106.863, 106.867, 106.872, 106.876, 106.879, 106.903), 9.56, "#606060"),
  make_exons("PRKAR2B", c(107.043, 107.070, 107.122, 107.128, 107.141, 107.147, 107.151, 107.155), 9.57, "#111111"),
  make_exons("HBP1", c(107.151, 107.157, 107.162, 107.167, 107.172, 107.176, 107.182, 107.191), 9.29, "#464646"),
  make_exons("COG5", c(107.199, 107.205, 107.222, 107.229, 107.237), 9.56, "#696969")
)

write.csv(candidate_elements, "synthetic_candidate_elements.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(link_data, "synthetic_re2g_links.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gene_models, "synthetic_gene_models.csv", row.names = FALSE)

candidate_elements
```

## Multi-track figure

```{r figure, fig.width=16.5, fig.height=6.5, out.width='100%'}
track_colours <- c(
  promoter = "#00A087",
  promoter_class = "#8A8A8A",
  abc = "#3C8DAD",
  contact = "#7B2CBF",
  enhancer = "#E76F51",
  distance = "#C58B2A",
  genomic = "#202020"
)

track_labels <- tribble(
  ~label, ~y,
  "Genes", 9.56,
  "ENCODE-rE2G links", 8.55,
  "ENCODE-rE2G score", 7.70,
  "Candidate elements", 7.24,
  "DNase signal at P", 6.72,
  "Ubiquitously expressed gene", 6.08,
  "ABC score", 5.47,
  "Contact frequency (average Hi-C)", 4.69,
  "Activity of elements within 5 kb of E", 3.82,
  "Distance to TSS", 2.95,
  "No. of TSSs between E and P", 2.20,
  "No. of elements between E and P", 1.30
)

coordinate_ticks <- tibble(
  x = c(106.9, 107.0, 107.1, 107.2),
  label = c("106.9 Mb", "107 Mb", "107.1 Mb", "107.2 Mb")
)

legend_data <- tribble(
  ~label, ~colour, ~y,
  "Promoter activity", track_colours["promoter"], 8.88,
  "Promoter class", track_colours["promoter_class"], 8.03,
  "ABC score", track_colours["abc"], 7.18,
  "3D contact", track_colours["contact"], 6.33,
  "Nearby enhancers", track_colours["enhancer"], 5.48,
  "Distance to TSS", track_colours["distance"], 4.63,
  "Genomic features", track_colours["genomic"], 3.78
)

separator_data <- tibble(
  y = c(8.18, 7.18, 6.45, 5.79, 5.08, 4.28, 3.47, 2.66, 1.82, 0.95)
)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = separator_data,
    aes(x = region_start, xend = region_end, y = y, yend = y),
    colour = "#C8C8C8", linewidth = 0.42
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = region_start, xend = region_end, y = 9.82, yend = 9.82),
    colour = "#202020", linewidth = 0.62
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = coordinate_ticks,
    aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 9.77, yend = 9.87),
    linewidth = 0.50, colour = "#202020"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = coordinate_ticks,
    aes(x = x, y = 10.03, label = label),
    size = 4.0, colour = "#252525"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = gene_models,
    aes(
      x = plot_start, xend = plot_end,
      y = gene_y, yend = gene_y,
      colour = gene_colour
    ),
    linewidth = 0.62,
    arrow = grid::arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(1.4, "mm")),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = gene_exons,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = exon_colour),
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = gene_models,
    aes(x = label_x, y = gene_y + 0.01, label = gene),
    hjust = 1, fontface = "italic", size = 4.0,
    colour = "#303030"
  ) +
  geom_curve(
    data = link_data,
    aes(
      x = element_position, xend = promoter_position,
      y = 8.18, yend = 8.18,
      linewidth = link_strength,
      group = element_id
    ),
    curvature = 0.24,
    colour = track_colours["enhancer"],
    alpha = 0.82,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(
      xmin = position_mb - 0.00062,
      xmax = position_mb + 0.00062,
      ymin = 7.22,
      ymax = 7.22 + 0.62 * re2g_score
    ),
    fill = track_colours["enhancer"], colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(
      xmin = position_mb - 0.00072,
      xmax = position_mb + 0.00072,
      ymin = 7.02,
      ymax = 7.13
    ),
    fill = track_colours["genomic"], colour = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = promoter_position - 0.00145,
    xmax = promoter_position + 0.00145,
    ymin = 6.46, ymax = 7.12,
    fill = track_colours["promoter"], colour = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment", x = promoter_position, xend = promoter_position,
    y = 5.82, yend = 6.45,
    colour = track_colours["promoter_class"], linewidth = 1.15
  ) +
  annotate(
    "point", x = promoter_position, y = 6.09,
    colour = track_colours["promoter_class"], size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(
      xmin = position_mb - 0.00052,
      xmax = position_mb + 0.00052,
      ymin = 5.09,
      ymax = 5.09 + 0.63 * abc_score
    ),
    fill = track_colours["abc"], colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(
      xmin = position_mb - 0.00070,
      xmax = position_mb + 0.00070,
      ymin = 4.29,
      ymax = 4.29 + 0.70 * contact_frequency / 0.22
    ),
    fill = track_colours["contact"], colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(
      xmin = position_mb - 0.00065,
      xmax = position_mb + 0.00065,
      ymin = 3.48,
      ymax = 3.48 + 0.69 * nearby_activity / 4200
    ),
    fill = track_colours["enhancer"], colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(x = position_mb, y = 2.74 + 0.64 * distance_scaled),
    colour = track_colours["distance"], linewidth = 0.68
  ) +
  geom_step(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(x = position_mb, y = 1.88 + 0.60 * tss_between),
    colour = track_colours["genomic"], linewidth = 0.72,
    direction = "mid"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = candidate_elements,
    aes(x = position_mb, y = 1.02 + 0.66 * elements_between / max(elements_between)),
    colour = track_colours["genomic"], linewidth = 0.72
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = track_labels,
    aes(x = 106.804, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 1, size = 3.75, colour = "#303030"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 7.81, label = "1", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 7.23, label = "0", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 6.96, label = "0.8", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 6.48, label = "0", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 6.30, label = "Yes", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 5.91, label = "No", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 5.69, label = "1", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 5.10, label = "0", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 4.99, label = "0.22", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 4.30, label = "0", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 4.15, label = "4,000", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 3.49, label = "0", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 106.835, y = 2.75, label = "0 kb", hjust = 1, size = 3.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 107.257, y = 9.58, label = "Feature categories", hjust = 0, size = 4.1) +
  geom_segment(
    data = legend_data,
    aes(x = 107.258, xend = 107.266, y = y, yend = y, colour = colour),
    linewidth = 1.15,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = legend_data,
    aes(x = 107.270, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 0, size = 3.75, colour = "#303030"
  ) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(0.45, 1.1), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(106.68, 107.37),
    ylim = c(0.76, 10.22),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave(
  "regulatory_genomic_tracks.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 16.5,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 330,
  bg = "white"
)

p
```
